intro: This trial marks the critical moment in a shaman's attunement to fire atop the peaks of Durotar. Guided by the hermit Telf Joolam, the initiate must drink a potent fire sapta to perceive and confront a Minor Manifestation of Fire. Slaying the spirit yields a glowing ember, used to kindle the brazier at the Shrine of Eternal Flame and light the ceremonial torch.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The fire sapta is finished. The time has come for you to face the flame. Use the sapta at the shrine and head to the top of the mountain to face the manifestation there. He will not attack until you are ready, but he will realize you are able to see him.
Strike him down swiftly, friend, for he shall only grow in power the longer you take to slay him. Once he is defeated, place his glowing embers within the brazier and light the torch.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The brazier stands about a third your height, and looks normal, save for the inscriptions along its smooth metal rails. The metal shows no signs of wear from the weather, and the bowl seated at the top of it feels cool to the touch.

clips.title: Completion
paras: A white hot flame ignites within the bowl as you place the ember within. You can feel the magical effects of the sapta coursing through your body and the fire dances rhythmically before you.
You place the top of the torch within the basin, and it immediately catches on fire.
